items.computation: Letter is dated Thu 19.11.2026 and was sent by ordinary post by a Hamburg authority, so under § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this deemed-delivery rule itself). The one-month Widerspruch period then starts the following day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (24.11.2026) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the starting event, i.e. Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in Hamburg (not a weekend or holiday), so no shift is needed. Final day the Widerspruch must reach the Bezirksamt: 23.12.2026.
